concepts.title: The Greatest of All: Factors in Common

questions.q: Two numbers 60 and 72 have HCF 12 with coprime multipliers 5 and 6. Verify by computing hcf = 12 x 1; then find the HCF value.
Find the LCM of 60 and 72 given their HCF is 12 and HCF x LCM = product of the numbers.
The LCM of 60 and 72 is 360. Use HCF x LCM = a x b to find their HCF.
Two ropes of lengths 60 cm and 72 cm are cut into equal pieces of greatest length. What is the length of each piece?
Two bells ring together now. They ring at intervals of 60 minutes and 72 minutes. After how many minutes will they next ring together?
How many multiples of 36 are there up to 100?
Two numbers 24 and 36 have HCF 12 with coprime multipliers 2 and 3. Verify by computing hcf = 12 x 1; then find the HCF value.
Find the LCM of 24 and 36 given their HCF is 12 and HCF x LCM = product of the numbers.
The LCM of 24 and 36 is 72. Use HCF x LCM = a x b to find their HCF.
Two ropes of lengths 24 cm and 36 cm are cut into equal pieces of greatest length. What is the length of each piece?
Two bells ring together now. They ring at intervals of 24 minutes and 36 minutes. After how many minutes will they next ring together?
How many multiples of 24 are there up to 120?
Two numbers 5 and 25 have HCF 5 with coprime multipliers 1 and 5. Verify by computing hcf = 5 x 1; then find the HCF value.
Find the LCM of 5 and 25 given their HCF is 5 and HCF x LCM = product of the numbers.
The LCM of 5 and 25 is 25. Use HCF x LCM = a x b to find their HCF.
Two ropes of lengths 5 cm and 25 cm are cut into equal pieces of greatest length. What is the length of each piece?
Two bells ring together now. They ring at intervals of 5 minutes and 25 minutes. After how many minutes will they next ring together?
How many multiples of 36 are there up to 150?
Fermat's Last Theorem says x^n + y^n = z^n has no positive solutions for n > 2. For n = 3 compute 5^3 - (3^3 + 4^3) to see it is not zero.
Check whether 6 is a perfect number: its proper divisors are 1, 2 and 3. Find their sum.
The numbers 11 and 13 are consecutive primes. How far apart are they (twin primes differ by 2)?
Are 8 and 15 co-prime? Their common factors are only 1, so their HCF is what?
Divisibility by 9: a number is divisible by 9 when its digit sum is. Find the digit sum of 729 and report the digit sum.
Divisibility by 11: add and subtract alternate digits of 2728 from the right (8 - 2 + 7 - 2) and report the result.
